description: This file defines the MenuStringRenderer interface in the org.apache.ofbiz.widget.renderer package, outlining methods for rendering menu components and elements such as menu items, links, images, and wrappers in a web UI framework.

methods.name: renderMenuItem
methods.description: Renders a menu item element using the provided writer, context, and menu item model.

methods.name: renderMenuOpen
methods.description: Renders the opening part of a menu.

methods.name: renderMenuClose
methods.description: Renders the closing part of a menu.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperOpen
methods.description: Renders the opening of a simple wrapper around menu content.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperClose
methods.description: Renders the closing of a simple wrapper around menu content.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperRows
methods.description: Renders rows within a simple wrapper; accepts an Object as menu parameter.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders a hyperlink within the menu.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image element in the menu.
